troes: Trōs, Trōis (m.) — a Trojan (nom. pl., Greek form Trōes)

turnus: Turnus, -ī (m.) — Turnus, young king of the Rutulians, suitor of Lavinia (nom. sg.)

undique: undique (adv.) — from all sides, on every side

unus: ūnus, -a, -um — one, alone, a single (m. nom. sg.)
ut: ut (conj.) — + subj. so that, in order that; + indic. as, when, how

venientem: veniō, -īre, vēnī, ventum — to come, approach (pres. part., m./f. acc. sg.)
versat: versō, -āre — to turn over, ponder (3rd sg. pres.)

vertice: vertex, verticis (m.) — peak, summit; whirl (abl. sg.)
vertit: vertō, vertere, vertī, versum — to turn, change (3rd sg. pres./perf.)
vestris: vester, vestra, vestrum — your (pl.) (m./f./n. abl./dat. pl.)
veterumque: vetus, -eris — old, ancient; veterēs, forefathers, ancestors (m. gen. pl.) + -que, and

volnus: vulnus (volnus), vulneris (n.) — wound (acc./nom. sg.; older spelling)
